name: security-review
description: Security review of task changes: threat modeling, OWASP ASVS L1 checklist, auth/authz flow tracing, dependency/secret scan reminders. Distinct from review-hard (general risk) and repo-consistency-sweep (pattern matching). Use when the task touches authentication, authorization, public endpoints, PII, crypto, or external integrations, or names an auth or biometric change with no security-review. Do not use when nothing is implemented yet or there is no security surface (pure docs, internal tooling with no user data). Opt-in --consistency N consensus mode.
